title: pubrun Manifest
description: Schema for a pubrun execution manifest.

meta_ref.description: Optional path to a parent meta.json snapshot for HPC parent-child manifest hydration.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension sections contributed by plugins.

selected_behavior.description: Effective import-mode behavior flags for the selected mode. Null until a mode is selected. Manifests written before 2026-06-20 carry only auto_start and global_hooks.

global_hooks.description: Obsolete unified flag kept for backward compatibility; true when process-global hooks are permitted.

patch_subprocesses.description: The mode permits the subprocess spy.

patch_console.description: The mode permits redirecting sys.stdout and sys.stderr (console tee).

signal_hooks.description: The mode permits signal and excepthook handlers.

force_console.description: The mode forces the console tee on regardless of capture_mode. Present only for the full mode.

data_files.description: Tracked input datasets, output files, mixed read/write files, and optional run-wide hashing summary.

utc_datetime.description: POSIX epoch float (time.time()). Stored as floats for sub-second precision, timezone-agnostic storage, trivial arithmetic, and deterministic serialization.

required_by.description: In imported-transitive mode, the imported packages that require this (transitive) dependency.

import_names.description: Sorted list of observed import names mapped to this distribution when source is imported.

observed_at.description: Lifecycle stage(s) at which an imported distribution was observed.

snapshot_stage.description: Capture stage for this package snapshot: startup, final (merged), or single (standalone).

unresolved.description: Modules or dependencies that could not be mapped cleanly to a unique installed distribution.

local_modules.description: Sorted list of loaded local-only top-level module names outside site-packages.

coverage_notes.description: Factual notes describing capture coverage boundaries for this snapshot.

floating_point_precision.description: Information about floating point capabilities (e.g. FP32, FP64, TF32).

notices.description: Non-disruptive config notices recorded at run time (e.g. a deprecated, inert core.profile). Never raised into the host; surfaced by pubrun status/inspect/show.

timestamp_utc.description: POSIX epoch timestamp when the signal was received.

signals_received.description: List of OS signals received during execution.

signals_truncated.description: Number of additional signals omitted after the per-run cap of 1000 recorded signals was reached. Present only when greater than 0.

exit_code.description: Process exit code captured at finalization. Null if unknown.

exit_exception.description: String representation of the exit-causing exception, if any.
